lines.en: Sakaki-bar-a — a place where everyone knows your name. Unless your name is Akira.
If that’s the case, chances are you didn’t even know your name until recently. And also, you have a terrible hobby/addiction and need to find a new one ASAP.
Anyway, a quick taxi ride takes us right up to the doors, but I notice right away that things don’t seem as...hectic as they’ve been lately.
The streets are quiet and empty, and the only sound that can be heard apart from my two friends bickering is the electric hum of a new sign Sara bought with some of the bar’s profits.
I push open the doors and guide the two of them to my normal seat, which isn’t entirely necessary as it’s not their first time here, but it does make me feel cool.
But what makes me feel even cooler is that Sana, who appears to be the only one working tonight, quickly brings all three of us beers without me even needing to part my lips.
Which brings us to now, roughly thirty minutes and three beers deep into the night as smooth jazz drones on in the background.
: Say, why don’t we come here more often? I didn’t even realize this place was open for non-events and shit.
: Do you think it might have something to do with the fact that our regular bar is only a couple blocks away from my apartment?
: I have no clue. That’s why I asked.
: Okay. Well, I think it has something to do with the fact that our regular bar is only a couple blocks away from my apartment.
: Wakana and Osako don’t live that close by, though.

: Yeah, but you know the two of them are getting up to no good on the train. Wouldn’t put it past either of them to stakeout the busiest cars during rush hour just so they can live out some fantasies.
: I fingered Rie on the train once. But I’m a ninja so no one noticed.
: Very nice, Rika. But you might want to watch what you’re saying in front of one of the girls who is literally in the club you advise.
: Oh, right. Hi Sana. Please don’t report me to upper management. They’re scary and I need money for rat college.
: You don’t have to worry about that...I’ve heard much worse from my mom’s friends and-
: Did you say “rat college?”
: It’s for her son.
: Yup! But I just found out he doesn’t have much time left...
: I’m sure...Rin will be happy to...not be an only child anymore...even if it’s only for a little while...
: Can you get me another beer, Sana? Whenever you have a second.
: Mhm. I just need to...finish putting away the wine glasses...I’m running behind since...I’m working alone again tonight...
: Yeah, the hot biker girl was here last time!
: Where’s she tonight? I have to get her number and find out how she feels about the female body. Or how she feels the female body. Whatever comes first. Probably her. I’m a ninja.
: I...actually don’t know...
: She was supposed to work tonight, but...she just...hasn’t shown up, so...I’m just glad we’re slow...
: Has that happened before? I thought Yuki had been really good when it came to work stuff?
: New boyfriend maybe? Girlfriend? Did I manifest her into being gay? If so, I’m sorry. Just not really.
: Bitch, you two have talked like one time. Keep yo’ damn pants on.
: Well gee, Imani. Sorry. Not all of us can just willingly be abstinent for seven years.
: She’s...never done this before, but...I’m sure she just...made a mistake when she...looked at the schedule or something...
: It’s not a...big deal...
: Do you...actually have a crush on her?...
: No, she just has a crush on everyone.
: Perpetual loneliness will do that to a person.
: Ninjas do not know emotion. I’m a lone wolf who stalks the shadows. I just think it’d be cool to make out with her.
: Yeah...I’m pretty sure my mom does too...
: Man! Isn’t there anyone around here who isn’t already interested in somebody else? Am I really gonna have to date that Nodoka girl who keeps trying to pull me into the storage room?
: Yeah, you’re gonna want to stay as far away from her as possible. And I ain’t just saying that because of the age gap.
: I know. Shit’s just hard, man.
: You go from thinking you’re gonna be spending the rest of your life with one girl...raising a kid together...buyin’ a damn house...and then it’s just over? That’s it?
: Like...I’m not trying to bring down the mood since this is supposed to be a celebration and all, I just wish I had somebody to share happy moments with, you know?
: And now, to top things off, I might have to watch Wakana and Osako go through the same song and dance I had with Rie. There’s just misery and lesbian sadness everywhere I look. Rin and Otoha too.
: Rin will be fine. It seems like she’s basically over Otoha already.
: Yeah, but that probably means she’s just gonna fall for Chika again and get a third dose of heartbreak before I even get a shot at a second.
: Rika, as someone who’s...already been through a tough breakup...what do you think is going to happen to Wakana and Osako?
: That’s...tough. Nobody on the outside can ever really understand what’s going on in somebody else’s relationship.
: My gut instinct is that they’ll be able to work through it. But my gut’s not always right since I thought I’d be able to work stuff out with my partner too.

: Neither of them really, like...talk to me the way you guys do. So it’s not like I really know what’s going on in the first place. I just...feel the tension. The bad kind. Not the kind you guys have.
: But I guess the bright side to all of this sad stuff is that you two are actually hooking up now!
: Uh...you okay, Sana?
: I’m fine.
: That glass was just a little slippery, that’s all.
: You...need us to help clean it up or anything?
: No, that’s okay. But I think I might have cut my hand.
: Sensei, could you come to the kitchen and help me wrap it up please?
: Uh...sure.
: I’ll be...right back, I guess.
: Are those two fucking?
: Rika, ew! What the fuck?!
: What?! That felt weird as hell, didn’t it?!
: So your gut instinct is to think they’re having sex?!
: I already told you my gut’s been wrong before! I’m just calling it like I see it! I hope it’s not true either! That’s gross and bad news for you!
: Hah...that was just a one time thing, unfortunately. It’s not like we’re actually dating.
: True. But, speaking from experience, you don’t go down on somebody for hours at a time if you don’t want to date them.
: Once you pass the sixty-minute mark, it means something. So at least you’ve got that, buddy.
: You really think that’s true?...
: Absolutely. Not a doubt in my mind.
: AAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!!!!
: You’ve gotta tell me all about it. How’d it happen? Did he actually know what he was doing? Was it really just oral? Spare no detail. I must know.
: It was amazing. And so unexpected too. I had no idea it was even coming.
: Was it at your place? His place? Love hotel? Where?
: A room at an inn on the beach. The place we use for all the class beach trips.
: You did it during the class beach trip?! You frisky little freaks, you!
: It was right before the class trip, actually. We went there on...our own. With nobody else.
: We spent the whole day together...I told him some stuff about my past...
: Then, when we went back to the room, I showed him my swimsuit and he was just like “take it off!” So of course I was nervous as hell but...oh my god.
: I kid you not, I had no idea it was even physically possible to cum so many times in one- are you crying?
: I’m just...so happy for you...
: Me too, man! But don’t cry! You’re killing the vibe and I want to tell you more about how friggin’ awesome it was.
: I’m sorry, I’m sorry! I’d just given up on the possibility of the two of you ever getting together, so this is all so crazy to me.
: Well, don’t just...count me out, yo. Senpai and I have been close since day one. I wouldn’t have been able to hold out as long as I have if I didn’t think it was possible.
: Of course it’s possible! It’s obviously possible. It basically happened. I just figured it was going to be Wakana before you.
: But...Wakana’s with Osako. The two of them have been together since college. We literally just talked about this.
: I mean, yeah. But you see the way she and Akira look at each other sometimes, right?
: Are you really gonna look at me and tell me those two don’t want to fuck each other into a coma? We all know it. Hell, Osako probably knows it too. That might be why they’re fighting.
: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait. There’s no way Senpai would be the reason they’re fighting. And just because they might want to take each other’s clothes off doesn’t mean Wakana actually would.
: She loves Osako. She tells me about it all the time. She’s loyal as all hell.
: I’m not saying she would actually cheat. Just that if I were in Osako’s shoes and I had a feeling my partner wanted to screw somebody else, I’d probably say or do some pretty stupid shit.
: Yeah, but you say and do pretty stupid shit all the time without being in that very specific scenario, so that’s just...not a good sample.
: And that’s a totally fair counterpoint thingy! I probably am wrong. You’re the one he actually hooked up with in the end, so you’re the one who’s winning now.
: Saying I’m winning makes it sound like a contest, though...
: Love is a contest, Imani. And it’s one that never ends, so you’ve always gotta be competing.
: There are like ten million people on this planet, and any one of them could snatch away the person you’re after if you let your guard down. You gotta remember that.
: Rika, there are almost eight billion people on earth.
: Wha- well, that’s like five times worse, damn it!
: How did you get a job at a school?
: How did you get a job at being eaten out by a hot young stud?!
: That isn’t my job, you friggin’ weirdo!
: Yeah, but it should be!
: I know Akira’s type, Imani. I hooked up with plenty of dudes like that in my teens who probably went on to bang like a hundred girls. Which is why I’m telling you you’ve gotta lock that dude down.
: Sex might be the goal right now, but that’s not all you really want in the end, is it? You want somebody to share happy moments with too. You’re like me. New me. Not old me.
: Well, technically old me. But old me is the new me.
: Old like age. Like, new me is old of age. And old me is-
: Yeah, I get what you’re trying to say. And...
: And...you’re right. Maybe this is one big contest. But could you really say I’m winning right now when we’ve only done shit one time?
: As a matter of fact, I’m almost positive I’m losing since he fucked some other girl like crazy in the room right next door to me once. I just can’t say who since I signed an NDA.
: Then that’s all the more reason to fight, girl. You’ve come this far, haven’t you? Go give that dude the ride of his life. So long as that’s not what Sana’s doing as we speak.
: Wait, yeah. Those two have been gone for a while.
: I said what I said and I won’t say it again.
: Do you...
: Do you think we should, like...go check on them?
: I don’t know. I kinda want to stay out here and keep talking about sex since, depressingly, you are now defeating me in that area of my life.
: Well, hopefully you’ll be able to convert the neighbor soon.
: Hopefully. Because other than that, my best option seems to be becoming the third member of a threesome with you and Akira. And I can’t do that without disrupting the dynamic of our friend group.
: I mean...would it reeeeeeally disrupt anything?
: Can’t some friends just have a one-off night of...sexual exploration without completely changing the dynamic of-
: You motherfucker.
: It wasn’t my idea! I wanted a nice, old-fashioned one-on-one encounter! They pressured me!
: Unforgivable! You participated in a night of platonic passion while I was feeding a cheese wheel to a rat?!?! How could you do this to me?!
: It was before you ever met the rat! I swear!
: Hey. What’s going on? What happened with the-
: You! Both of you! Let me smell you! I need to make sure nothing inappropriate happened!
: Wha- Sensei?!
: Run.
: I...aah! The wound on my...hand reopened! I must...dress it!
: Get back here or I’ll never teach you paradiddles, damn it!
: I don’t even know what that means!!!!!
Sana manages to escape, and I manage to go undetected as Rika thoroughly inspects my body and finds nothing. Probably because I never laid a finger on Sana the entire time I was in the kitchen.
That does not mean, however, that she did not lay a finger on me.
Or a mouth.
On my penis.
But that is beside the point.
I sit back down at the counter and quickly find that I still have not received the new beer I asked for earlier. Probably because the bartender was going down on me.
That’s fine, though. It’s getting late anyway.
Imani and Rika finish their drinks a short while later. But, before we leave, there’s a moment of silence where the three of us just...sit there.
The jazz music continues to drone on and Rika closes her eyes. But I’m unsure of whether or not she’s just tired or absorbed in the song.
Regardless, it gives me the chance for one more bout of prolonged eye contact with Imani...and she smiles that same smile she always does.
But the light blue in her eyes seems a little bit darker and I can’t tell quite why.
We leave the bar. All three of us. And I never get to say goodbye to Sana. Nor do I get to see Imani and Rika off as it makes more sense for me to just head home from here.
I had a good time, though.
I hope they did too.
Rika’s affection has increased to [rika_love]!
Imani’s affection has increased to [imani_love]!
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
